Name: Visible Pond Fish
Author: huykyo123
Description:
[center][size=6][b]🐟 Visible Pond Fish 🐟[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]Bring your farm's fish ponds to life![/i][/size][/center]

[center][quote][size=3][b][color=#4fc3f7]✨ Latest Update: Version 1.0.1 ✨[/color][/b]
Added [b]Animated Swimming[/b]! Fish now realistically wiggle their tails and swim around using their aquarium sprite assets. Includes full support for [b]Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)[/b] and other custom fish mods![/size][/quote][/center]

[size=4][b][color=#ffd54f]☀️ Introduction[/color][/b][/size]
Are you tired of looking at dark, mysterious black shapes swimming around in your fish ponds? Do you wish you could actually see the vibrant colors of your Lava Eels, Void Salmon, or Rainbow Trout without having to label them with signs?

[b]Visible Pond Fish[/b] changes the rendering of pond occupants from flat black silhouettes to their [b]true, full-colored sprites[/b]. Watch them swim, wiggle, dive, and cast soft shadows onto the pond bed just like fish in the wild!

[line]

[size=4][b][color=#81c784]✨ Key Features[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Full Color Visuals:[/b] Fish swimming under the surface render using their actual colored sprites instead of a flat black shadow.[/*]
[*][b]Animated Swimming [color=#81c784](New!)[/color]:[/b] Fish realistically swim and wiggle their tails! The mod automatically reads the game's aquarium data sheet to use active swimming frames.[/*]
[*][b]Depth Blending:[/b] Fish automatically fade and blur as they dive deeper, blending naturally with the water depth.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Shadows:[/b] Renders a soft shadow offset underneath each fish, creating a sense of volume and depth under the water.[/*]
[*][b]Fully Customizable:[/b] Fully integrated with [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b]! Open the menu in-game to adjust:
- Fish Opacity (how clearly you can see them through the water)
- Toggle shadows on/off
- Shadow opacity & vertical offset[/*]
[*][b]100% Client-side & Safe:[/b] This is a purely cosmetic rendering mod. It does not alter your save files, item tables, or game mechanics. You can safely add or remove it at any time![/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b][color=#4fc3f7]🤝 Mod Compatibility[/color][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+:[/b] Fully compatible and built for the latest game versions.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-Species Fish Pond:[/b] [color=#ffb74d][i]Perfect Harmony![/i][/color] If you use my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47401]Multi-Species Fish Pond[/url] , you will see all the different species swimming together in their true individual colors in the same pond. No more mixed-up black shapes![/*]
[*][b]Custom Modded Fish & SVE:[/b] Works automatically with custom fish added by other mods (e.g. SVE, Ridgeside). Fish will use their custom aquarium swimming sprites if available, with a safe fallback to their standard item icons.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=4][b][color=#ba68c8]💾 Installation[/color][/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (optional but recommended).[/*]
[*]Download this mod.[/*]
[*]Extract the zip file into your [color=#81c784]Stardew Valley/Mods[/color] directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI![/*]
[/list]
